LATE PU-8
xStation ODE installation guide for LATE PU-8 Playstation 1 motherboards
The LATE PU-8 mainboards can be found in: Most SCPH-1001 and SCPH-1002 Most SCPH-3000 Most SCPH-3500 All SCPH-5000
Why the mainboard called “LATE”, and is there an “EARLY”? Literally, yes! The PU-8 came in two major flavors (EARLY and LATE). You can check which mainboard you have by looking for these marks:
1. Mainboard labels
- EARLY mainboards are labeled PU-8-11
- LATE mainboards are labeled PU-8-21/22/23 or 41

- the upper right corner
- the upper left corner. (The spacers are a bit too long for installation in a PU-8. We recommend that you shorten them a bit, so that the xStation pcb rests securely.)
